gbm_population_evidence.quote: Stress Disorders, Post-Traumatic; Sexually Transmitted Infection (STI) Prevention
Gay, bisexual, queer, and other men who have sex with men (GBM) continue to bear a disproportionate burden of the sexually transmitted and blood-borne infections (STBBI)

coder_notes: 'GBM' here means gay, bisexual and other men who have sex with men; the trial concerns PTSD and STI prevention via a behavioural intervention, not glioblastoma (not anti-GBM disease either, so not_glioblastoma). Phase NA. No drug or biologic interventions.
